title: Braymil Stage 1 Infant Formula
subtitle: Infant Formula • 0 to 6 months
desc: Braymil 1 is a stage 1 infant formula specially developed for babies from birth to 6 months, with balanced nutrition and a 60:40 whey-casein ratio.
use: Use only under the guidance of a healthcare professional. Prepare exactly as instructed on the pack using safe water and clean, sterilized feeding equipment.
notice: Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Infant formula should be used only on the advice of a healthcare professional.

title: Braymil 2 Follow Up Formula
subtitle: Stage 2 • 6 to 12 months
desc: Braymil 2 is a follow-up formula developed for babies after 6 months, providing balanced nutrition alongside complementary foods.
use: Use alongside age-appropriate complementary foods and only as advised by a healthcare professional. Follow pack preparation directions carefully.
notice: Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Follow-up formula should be used as part of a diversified diet and under appropriate guidance.

title: Braymil 3 Follow Up Formula
subtitle: Stage 3 • 12 to 24 months
desc: Braymil 3 is a growing-up formula for toddlers aged 12 to 24 months, developed to support increasing nutritional needs during active growth.
use: Serve as part of a varied, balanced diet. Follow the preparation and serving instructions printed on the product pack.
notice: For children 12 months and above. Use as part of a varied diet; consult your child’s healthcare professional when needed.

title: Braymil Premium 1 Formula
subtitle: Premium Stage 1 • 0 to 6 months
desc: Braymil Premium 1 is a Stage 1 infant formula for birth to 6 months with DHA, ARA, whey protein, prebiotics, vitamins and minerals.
use: Use only under healthcare professional guidance. Prepare one feed at a time according to the pack directions and discard leftover feed.
notice: Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Infant formula should be used only on the advice of a healthcare professional.

title: Braymil Premium 1 Infant Formula
subtitle: Premium Stage 1 • 0 to 6 months
desc: Braymil Premium 1 is a premium infant formula for babies from birth to 6 months, formulated with DHA, ARA, whey protein, prebiotics and micronutrients.
use: Use only under healthcare professional guidance. Follow the exact preparation, hygiene and storage directions on the label.
notice: Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Infant formula should be used only on the advice of a healthcare professional.

title: Braymil Premium 2 Follow Up Formula
subtitle: Premium Stage 2 • 6 to 12 months
desc: Braymil Premium 2 is a premium Stage 2 follow-up formula for babies aged 6 to 12 months, with DHA, ARA, whey protein, GOS, FOS, vitamins and minerals.
use: Use alongside complementary foods and under appropriate healthcare guidance. Follow label preparation directions exactly.
notice: Mother’s milk is best for your baby. Follow-up formula is intended for older infants as part of a diversified diet.

title: Braymil Premium 3 Follow Up Formula
subtitle: Premium Stage 3 • 12 months+
desc: Braymil Premium 3 is a follow-up formula for children 12 months and above, enriched with DHA, ARA, whey protein, prebiotics, vitamins and minerals.
use: Use as part of a varied and balanced diet. Follow the preparation and serving directions on the product label.
notice: For children 12 months and above. Use as part of a varied diet and consult a healthcare professional if you have feeding concerns.

title: Braymil LF Lactose-Free Formula
subtitle: Specialized nutrition • 0 to 24 months
desc: Braymil LF is a lactose-free formula for infants and toddlers aged 0–24 months, formulated for sensitive digestion with GOS, FOS, MCT and whey protein.
use: Specialized formula should be used under healthcare professional guidance. Follow the preparation instructions and age guidance on the pack.
notice: Specialized infant nutrition should be selected with healthcare professional guidance. Mother’s milk is best for babies.

title: Braymil AAF Hypoallergenic Infant Formula
subtitle: Amino acid-based specialized formula
desc: Braymil AAF is an amino acid-based hypoallergenic formula developed for babies with cow milk protein allergy and severe food allergies.
use: Use only under direct medical or dietetic supervision. Follow the healthcare professional’s feeding plan and the product label exactly.
notice: This is a specialized formula for medical nutritional needs. Use only under the supervision of a qualified healthcare professional.

title: Braymil Preterm Infant Formula
subtitle: For preterm & low birth weight infants
desc: Braymil Pre-Term Formula LBW is developed for premature and low birth weight infants with higher nutritional needs.
use: Use only under neonatal or pediatric supervision. Feeding volume, concentration and duration must be determined by the healthcare team.
notice: For specialized medical nutritional use in preterm or low birth weight infants. Use only under healthcare professional supervision.

title: Braymil MF Milk Fortifier
subtitle: Fortifier for premature babies
desc: Braymil MF is a milk fortifier developed to enhance the nutritional value of expressed mother’s milk for premature and low birth weight infants.
use: Add only to expressed breast milk as directed by the neonatal healthcare team. Do not change concentration or frequency without medical instruction.
notice: Human milk fortifier is a specialized product for premature infants. Use only under neonatal or pediatric supervision.

title: Braymil Infant MCT Oil
subtitle: C8 + C10 medium-chain triglyceride oil
age: Infants & children with higher calorie needs
desc: Braymil MCT Oil is a C8/C10 medium-chain triglyceride oil designed to provide a concentrated, readily absorbed source of energy.
benefits: Useful where rapid energy is required
use: Dosage and method of use should be set by a healthcare professional based on nutritional needs. Do not exceed the advised amount.
notice: Use under healthcare professional or dietitian guidance, particularly for infants and children with medical nutritional needs.

title: Braymil Grow Chocolate
subtitle: Kids growth milk drink • 2 to 6 years
desc: Braymil Grow Chocolate is a kids growth milk drink powder for children aged 2–6 years, with DHA, protein, calcium, vitamins and minerals.
use: Prepare and serve according to the pack directions as part of a balanced diet. Adjust overall diet to the child’s age and nutritional needs.
notice: For children 2–6 years. This product is not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet.

title: Braymil Grow Vanilla
subtitle: Kids growth milk drink • 2 to 6 years
desc: Braymil Grow Vanilla is a kids growth milk drink powder for children aged 2–6 years, formulated with DHA, protein, calcium, prebiotics, vitamins and minerals.
use: Prepare and serve according to the pack directions as part of a balanced diet. Use age-appropriate serving sizes.
notice: For children 2–6 years. This product is not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet.

title: Braysure Mom Chocolate
subtitle: Maternal nutrition • Pregnancy & lactation
desc: Braysure Mom Chocolate is a maternal nutrition powder for pregnancy and lactation, enriched with protein, DHA, vitamins and minerals.
use: The current Braymil guidance suggests adding 2–3 heaped tablespoons to about 200 ml lukewarm or cold milk, mixing well and consuming daily.
notice: Use as part of a balanced diet. During pregnancy or lactation, follow your doctor or dietitian’s individual nutrition advice.

title: Braysure Mom Vanilla
subtitle: Maternal nutrition • Pregnancy & lactation
desc: Braysure Mom Vanilla is a maternal nutrition supplement developed for pregnancy and lactation with protein, DHA, vitamins and minerals.
use: Use according to pack directions and individual nutritional advice. Combine with a varied diet and appropriate prenatal or postnatal care.
notice: Use as part of a balanced diet. During pregnancy or lactation, follow your doctor or dietitian’s individual nutrition advice.
